title: BRACE risk acceptance (.brace/exceptions/<ITEM>-<slug>.yaml)
description: Field types are checked here. A missing or blank field is not a schema error: brace.py check reports it as an incomplete exception (an unresolved record finding), because a blank exception counts as an open gap. expires (or review_by) is optional: from that day (UTC) brace.py check reports the exception as expired, an open gap, and warns 30 days before. Approval comes from the merged pull request review, not from accepted_by.

expires.description: From this day (UTC) the risk acceptance no longer counts: brace.py check reports it as expired.

review_by.description: Same as expires, for teams that call it a review date.
